assumptions.notes: All unmeasured assumptions. A15: 40 g per rotating wheel assembly is the user-requested unmeasured estimate. Print density is an effective bulk estimate, not an infill calculation. Brake is ideal joint friction; no cam/contact validation. A8: 25x37x7 bearing uses SKF W61805-2RS1 reference mass 21.3 g; 8x16x5 bearing 5.9 g is a conservative solid-steel envelope estimate. Actual bearing selection unconfirmed. Digital servo v3.0 6V ratings used as optimistic instantaneous ceilings. A14: ideal synchronized dual hip servo, 2x stall torque, unchanged free speed; no thermal or supply sag model. A16: measured CAD export, per-part slicer mass for 4 walls/25% gyroid; PLA 1.24 g/cm3. Electronics/battery allowance remains 200g, unverified. Compact corner origins and underslung battery.

limitations: CAD visual meshes simplified with a 0.25 mm vertex grid; not manufacturing geometry
Bounding-box inertias; no calibrated mass properties
Capsule/box/cylinder collision proxies; not CAD interference validation
Ideal IMU and joint feedback, not evidence of sensors on real servos
Brake friction torque surrogate, no cam deformation, spring or pad model
Steering 40T/40T ideal joint equality; no backlash
